messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler went to Team Atlas, not Team Cinder; Team Cinder never owned it, and the Ember team no longer owns it. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-15; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Cinder; the Ember team no longer owns it. [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-09-05; recorded by handover/2025-08-29-scheduler]
    earlier: The scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- On 2025-11-07, Farah walked Marcus through the reporting service runbook. [valid 2025-11-07 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
- As of 2025-11-20, the event bus is owned by Team Boreal; Team Cinder kept it until then. [valid 2025-11-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-20-event-bus]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-26, the event bus is owned by Team Cinder; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-08-26 to 2025-11-20; recorded by handover/2025-08-26-event-bus]
    earlier: The event bus is owned by Team Atlas. [valid 2025-04-03 to 2025-08-26; recorded by handover/2025-04-03-event-bus]
    earlier: The event bus is owned by Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas; Team Boreal kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- On 2026-03-10, Team Dune observed that after Tuesday's deploy, the reporting service's p99 latency doubled. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to the Ember team. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-17-reporting-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-11-07 to 2025-11-17; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-11-07; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2025-05-09, the reporting service must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands. [constraint; valid 2025-05-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-05-09]
- As of 2025-09-15, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger; it reads from the event bus instead. [valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
    earlier: The reporting service depends on the ledger. [valid 2025-04-08 to 2025-09-15; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-08]
- The reporting service may be released only on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC, and any other release time requires an exception. [constraint; valid 2025-02-25 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-02-25]
- On 2025-09-15, Team Dune decided that the reporting service will read from the event bus instead of querying the ledger directly because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [decision; valid 2025-09-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-15]
- Team Cinder holds planning on Mondays. [valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-28]
- On 2025-03-17, Team Atlas handed the billing service to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
- On 2026-05-18, Oskar picked up the Ember team on-call shift from Diego. [valid 2026-05-18 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-18]
- On 2025-11-20, Team Boreal took over the event bus from Team Cinder. [valid 2025-11-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-20-event-bus]
- Team Cinder consists of Yuki; Diego Alvarez left the team on 2025-12-05. [valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-05]
    earlier: Team Cinder consists of Yuki and Diego. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-12-05; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-08]
- Team Atlas sits on the second floor. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-10-2]
- Team Dune sits on the fourth floor. [valid 2025-06-12 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-06-12]

Question: Which team owned reporting on 2025-06-25?

message.reasoning:
The question asks: which team owned the reporting service on 2025-06-25?

Memory entries about reporting ownership:
- "Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-11-07]" — this covers 2025-06-25.
- Later: moved from Team Dune to Team Boreal as of 2025-11-07; then to Ember team.

So on 2025-06-25, Team Dune owned it.
